etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From deference (or its Latin type *dēferentia) +‎ -al; compare essence, essential; prudence, prudential, etc. Coined by Scottish novelist, poet and playwright Walter Scott.
senses: Based on deference; based on the doctrine, ideology, or wishes of others rather than one's own conclusions.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
senses: (anatomy) Of or relating to the vas deferens.
